idea-plugin.name: HCL Assist
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Packer required-field templates across Amazon EBS, Docker, QEMU, VirtualBox ISO, provisioners, and shell-local post-processors.
  • Alternative inputs, communicator conditions, and project-defined requirement rules.
idea-plugin.description:
HCL completion and documentation for Terraform, OpenTofu, Packer, Nomad, and Consul.

  • Context-sensitive block, attribute, and function completion.
  • Required resource fields inserted as editable live templates using provider schemas.
  • Provider attribute documentation and required/optional field indicators.
  • Navigation to variables, locals, resources, modules, and Packer sources.
  • Project schemas and file-pattern overrides for custom HCL configurations.

Requires the Terraform and HCL plugin. Supports IntelliJ IDEA Community and Ultimate.

Documentation and source · Report an issue
